scope: Risk-based planned checks, not exhaustive possible failures and not executed tests.

cases.failure_case: Original bytes replaced by derivative
cases.expected_behavior: Original bytes, hash and revision-specific locator remain retrievable.

cases.failure_case: One source reused by multiple buildings or units
cases.expected_behavior: Share asset references and scoped links without duplicate storage or false attribution.

cases.failure_case: Remove one attachment link while other references exist
cases.expected_behavior: Only the requested link changes; geometry and referenced original remain intact.

cases.failure_case: Traversal, symlink, archive bomb or excessive recursion
cases.expected_behavior: Reject unsafe extraction before side effects; account for declared and expanded limits.

cases.failure_case: XML/CAD/URL input tries an uncontrolled external fetch
cases.expected_behavior: No arbitrary file/network access; explicit safe-reference policy and structured failure.

cases.failure_case: Unknown version, XYZ/XYZM or unsupported geometry variant
cases.expected_behavior: Retain/reject with explicit profile/loss result; never silently drop a dimension.
cases.required_when: First profiles; richer dimensional support only when elected

cases.failure_case: NaN, infinity, huge coordinates or malformed arrays
cases.expected_behavior: Reject finite/range/structure violations before geometry computation or allocation.

cases.failure_case: Swapped longitude/latitude or reflected axes
cases.expected_behavior: Use declared axes and reject ambiguous placement; known negative fixtures cannot pass by relabeling.

cases.failure_case: Metres, feet and millimetres across source fields
cases.expected_behavior: Convert once with defined units; quantity scaling and physical interpretation agree.

cases.failure_case: Already transformed coordinates are transformed again
cases.expected_behavior: Frame/revision references prevent double application; independent expected coordinates detect it.

cases.failure_case: Unknown or incompatible vertical reference
cases.expected_behavior: Valid local/2D work remains usable; dependent world 3D/clearance result is unavailable, not zero offset.

cases.failure_case: Two SRID-0 local origins treated as one frame
cases.expected_behavior: Transform through declared distinct frames before spatial comparison.

cases.failure_case: Scale-only, distorted or underdetermined plan calibration
cases.expected_behavior: Scale, geographic placement and vertical placement have separate gates and independent residual checks.

cases.failure_case: Concave footprint, courtyard or multipart building
cases.expected_behavior: Retain supported holes/parts and quantities; do not replace by bounding box.

cases.failure_case: Tiny slivers, degeneracy, touching versus positive overlap
cases.expected_behavior: Use an explicit profile tolerance and contact/overlap definition; no silent repair or arbitrary deletion.

cases.failure_case: Open mesh or visually closed but invalid solid
cases.expected_behavior: Rendering and valid-volume/intersection capability remain independent.
cases.required_when: First asset boundary; actual solid profile when elected

cases.failure_case: Roof outline, ground occupation, approved envelope and parcel differ
cases.expected_behavior: Retain separate roles; compare only compatible meanings and purposes.

cases.failure_case: Absent height, floor count, depth or final vertical bound
cases.expected_behavior: Show unknown and purpose-specific limits; never fabricate floors, infinite extents or safe clearance.

cases.failure_case: Same source ID appears in two dataset namespaces
cases.expected_behavior: Namespaces are preserved; no false canonical collision.

cases.failure_case: Equal names or close/overlapping geometry describe different things
cases.expected_behavior: Association remains explicit/source-backed; do not merge by proximity or label alone.

cases.failure_case: External ID has leading zeros, aliases or ambiguity
cases.expected_behavior: Retain raw string, scheme/issuer and ambiguity; no numeric truncation or guessed official validity.

cases.failure_case: Parcel/flat split, merge or rename
cases.expected_behavior: Stable identity survives renames; genuine splits/merges preserve lineage and retired IDs.
cases.required_when: Core lifecycle; full edit workflows later

cases.failure_case: Duplex, split-level, shared stair or repeated floor label
cases.expected_behavior: Use typed relationships; avoid duplicate counts and strict one-floor-per-unit assumptions.

cases.failure_case: One plan supports multiple units/revisions
cases.expected_behavior: Exact page/row/object links remain scoped; changing one unit does not overwrite another fact.

cases.failure_case: Identical input and operation are replayed
cases.expected_behavior: One persisted effect and stable returned identity, with duplicate delivery acknowledged.

cases.failure_case: Same file hash but mapping, frame or profile changes
cases.expected_behavior: Create a tracked new interpretation; do not return a stale cached receipt.

cases.failure_case: Concurrent duplicate imports race
cases.expected_behavior: Unique operation/identity constraints and transaction rules prevent duplicate effects.

cases.failure_case: A stale review or edit overwrites a newer revision
cases.expected_behavior: Expected-revision check rejects it and returns a recoverable conflict.

cases.failure_case: Observed, synthetic, future design or backdated correction mixed
cases.expected_behavior: Separate world, valid time, source time, recorded time and publication revision.

cases.failure_case: One bad contribution or interrupted acquisition hides missing items
cases.expected_behavior: Keep valid independent output, explicit item counts/completeness and failed roles.

cases.failure_case: A test points to the populated operator database/volume
cases.expected_behavior: Preflight refuses destructive test execution; isolation verified by resource identity, not only port.

cases.failure_case: Interrupted/repeated backfill or upgrade of nonempty DB
cases.expected_behavior: Checkpoint/recover deterministically; retain IDs/hashes/history; compare counts and key mappings.

cases.failure_case: Old client sees a new variant or revised meaning
cases.expected_behavior: Supported projection/version negotiation or explicit failure; no silent incorrect coercion.

cases.failure_case: Two subscribers share a pending fetch and one cancels
cases.expected_behavior: Deduplication remains correct; independent consumer is not accidentally cancelled.

cases.failure_case: Slow earlier response arrives after route or snapshot changes
cases.expected_behavior: Do not replace newer/current data; retain previous coherent snapshot during refresh where appropriate.

cases.failure_case: Access scope changes while requests/data are cached
cases.expected_behavior: Cancel/evict affected state and enforce access server-side; keying alone is insufficient.

cases.failure_case: Selected mesh unloads or is replaced at another LOD
cases.expected_behavior: Retain canonical selection and lazy detail lookup; stale primitive picks are rejected.

cases.failure_case: Map → register → unit → plan → back navigation
cases.expected_behavior: Entity, revision, selected level/unit and appropriate return camera remain coherent.

cases.failure_case: Selecting a feature or fitting extent while in 2D
cases.expected_behavior: Camera remains top-down and visible mode matches actual projection.

cases.failure_case: Held press then drag during React status updates
cases.expected_behavior: Movement/release listeners remain active; hold/drag/orbit and wheel-after-drag work.

cases.failure_case: Pointer cancel, window blur or a drag interpreted as click
cases.expected_behavior: Recover control state and pointer capture; navigation does not trigger an unintended selection.

cases.failure_case: Hidden/remounted view retains buffers and event listeners
cases.expected_behavior: Pause/unmount/release correctly; no accumulating inactive full worlds.

cases.failure_case: Building crosses two authoring blocks
cases.expected_behavior: One identity and full geometry with multiple memberships; no duplicated analytical quantities.

cases.failure_case: Road/utility/terrain crosses tiles or tile packaging changes
cases.expected_behavior: Neighbour boundaries, continuity and physical width agree; fragments resolve to canonical objects.

cases.failure_case: XY road crossing is grade separated or pipes are merely close
cases.expected_behavior: Do not invent connectivity; explicit system/network topology remains independent of projection.

cases.failure_case: Pipe centre/crown/invert or diameter confused with restriction corridor
cases.expected_behavior: Use correct quantity and level reference; depth binds to the relevant surface revision.

cases.failure_case: Road overlap is a subset of total parcel overhang
cases.expected_behavior: Do not sum overlapping regions as disjoint area; show exact result geometry and metric definitions.

cases.failure_case: LOD, clipping, explosion, style or camera changes
cases.expected_behavior: Fixed analytical revision retains identity and numerical results within its declared computational tolerance.

cases.failure_case: Source order, unrelated record or tile ID changes
cases.expected_behavior: Stable entity/component seeds and input signatures preserve unchanged appearance/geometry.

cases.failure_case: Child tile fails or arrives after rapid navigation
cases.expected_behavior: Keep valid coarse fallback, cancel stale work and avoid duplicate parent/child display.

cases.failure_case: Assets upload but DB commit fails, or vice versa
cases.expected_behavior: No half-publication becomes active; validate staged assets and keep prior coherent pointer.

cases.failure_case: Worker is killed or job delivered again
cases.expected_behavior: Bounded retries/checkpoints and idempotent effects; incomplete run status/counts recover honestly.

cases.failure_case: Geometry changes versus PDF/occupancy/style-only change
cases.expected_behavior: Rebuild actual dependent geometry/tiles; stale review and display invalidation remain distinct.

cases.failure_case: Raster no-data or cloud samples mistaken for ground/building records
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve surface meaning/resolution/time and assets; no row-per-sample or fabricated completeness.

cases.failure_case: Antimeridian, polar extent or unsupported analytical frame
cases.expected_behavior: Operate only within declared coverage; reject unsupported cases explicitly rather than distort.

cases.failure_case: Huge catalog mistaken for full visible workload
cases.expected_behavior: Bounded paging/coverage queries; separate catalog count, downloaded content and visible-frame capacity.

cases.failure_case: Material/picking/clipping extension unsupported by pinned version
cases.expected_behavior: Qualified fixture fails the engine gate; choose supported profile or record a concrete alternative decision.

cases.failure_case: Software GPU/headless results presented as physical-device performance
cases.expected_behavior: Record exact hardware/browser/DPR/workload; separate cold/warm and emulate/physical measurements.

cases.failure_case: WebGL context loss, corrupt asset or expired source URL
cases.expected_behavior: Recover or expose a usable limited state; quarantine bad content without destroying canonical data.

cases.failure_case: Small viewport, large text/zoom, keyboard or on-screen keyboard
cases.expected_behavior: Primary actions, panels and focus stay reachable; no trapped or hidden essential controls.

cases.failure_case: Status relies on color, drag alone or uncontrolled motion
cases.expected_behavior: Provide text/shape state, keyboard alternatives and reduced-motion behavior for essential actions.

cases.failure_case: Tiles, logs, thumbnails or exports disclose private content
cases.expected_behavior: Use allowlisted geometry-safe fields and permissioned detail/source routes; no secrets in artifacts.

cases.failure_case: Historical snapshot silently uses latest/private-unavailable source
cases.expected_behavior: Bind revision-specific evidence and permissions; unavailable or redacted content stays explicit.

cases.failure_case: Installing a data bundle overwrites subsequent local edits
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve additive semantics and stop identity conflicts; installation is not continuous sync.

cases.failure_case: Disk full, missing object or checksum mismatch
cases.expected_behavior: Fail safely with identifiable incomplete stage; do not fabricate replacement data or activate invalid content.

cases.failure_case: Multiple parsers/builds exhaust CPU/memory concurrently
cases.expected_behavior: Bounded concurrency, backpressure and cancellation with reconciled item/job status.

cases.failure_case: Undo/redo or reload modifies accepted/unrelated draft data
cases.expected_behavior: Undo is scoped to a known candidate revision; unsaved changes and recovery are explicit.

cases.failure_case: Blindly updating screenshots hides an actual regression
cases.expected_behavior: Require reasoned rebaseline and independent geometric/behavioral checks; preserve user visual decision.

cases.failure_case: Service image is treated as geometry or redistribution rights are missing
cases.expected_behavior: Keep content type, acquisition scope and source-use restrictions explicit; no inferred legal/semantic capability.

cases.failure_case: Proof directory resolves outside target or includes junctions
cases.expected_behavior: Stop exact-path cleanup before traversal; product/source/study folders remain protected.
